vinfast-vf6.author: Alexander Migl
vinfast-vf6.alt: VinFast VF 6 in dark green, front three-quarter view
vinfast-vf6.note: European VF 6 (Stuttgart, 2025), the same global design India assembles at Thoothukudi, in a green like India's Ivy Green: V-shaped light bar, split headlamps. Left-hand drive.

vinfast-vf6.author: Alexander Migl
vinfast-vf6.alt: VinFast VF 6 in dark green, rear three-quarter view
vinfast-vf6.note: Same European VF 6: V-shaped tail-lamp bar and VF 6 badge, identical to the Indian car.

vinfast-vf7.author: Ethan Llamas
vinfast-vf7.alt: VinFast VF 7 Eco in Crimson Red, front three-quarter view
vinfast-vf7.note: Philippine-market VF 7 Eco at a VinFast dealer (2026), the same global design India assembles; left-hand drive.

vinfast-vf7.author: Vnsg304
vinfast-vf7.alt: VinFast VF 7 in Jet Black, rear three-quarter view
vinfast-vf7.note: Vietnamese VF 7 on the road (2024): coupe-SUV roofline and V-shaped tail-lamp bar, the same body as the Indian VF 7. Motorcyclists in the background.

vinfast-vf-mpv-7.author: Ethan Llamas
vinfast-vf-mpv-7.alt: VinFast VF MPV 7 in silver, front three-quarter view
vinfast-vf-mpv-7.note: Philippine-market VF MPV 7 (2026), the private seven-seat version sold in India under the same name, not the Limo Green taxi. Left-hand drive; wet car.

vinfast-vf-mpv-7.author: Ethan Llamas
vinfast-vf-mpv-7.alt: VinFast VF MPV 7 in silver, rear three-quarter view
vinfast-vf-mpv-7.note: Same Philippine VF MPV 7: VF MPV 7 tailgate badge and V-shaped tail-lamp bar.
